narrative.details:
One of the most pervasive threats on Zephras Isle is the Al'Aketh Cult. They are religious zealots devoted to the worship of the supposed elemental ruler of Skywall, Al'Akir the Windlord. They are brutal, single minded, and their power and ambitions are growing more deadly by the day.

Your path will soon take you to Shen'dar Village to the south. Present yourself to Constable Aonda when you arrive. The cult threatens Shen'dar and they are in need of aid. Tell Aonda that I sent you.
narrative.objectives: Report to Constable Aonda in Shen'dar Village.
narrative.offerRewardText: Aetheen sent you, then? I'll confess, you don't look like much to me, but Shen'dar Village won't turn down willing aid, much less aid sent from Elder Aetheen herself.

chain.subtitle: 6 quests from level 3 to 5, 1,125 XP in all.

quests.name: Elemental Unrest
quests.objectiveText: Speak to the Yala Windwatcher in Thendal Grove.

quests.name: Agitators
quests.objectiveText: Slay 6 Roiling Winds and 7 Al'Aketh Converts in Thendal Grove.

quests.name: Return to Rorian
quests.objectiveText: Bring word of the Al'Aketh to Rorian the Dayseeker in Thendal Grove.

quests.name: Aetheen of the Gales
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Aetheen of the Gales in Thendal Grove.

quests.name: Foul Matriarch
quests.objectiveText: Slay 8 Ursera Scavengers and collect the head of the den mother, Urs'anah in Thendal Grove.

quests.name: The Next Step
quests.objectiveText: Report to Constable Aonda in Shen'dar Village.
